title: Test runs leave no session processes behind

requirements.text: After any test or probe run finishes, no genlock-host process started from a temporary folder is still running
requirements.check: ps -axo ppid=,command= | awk '$2==1 && /genlock-host run \/private\/tmp/' | wc -l prints 0 after the full test suite runs

requirements.text: Leftover session processes found on the Mac are reported or stopped automatically, instead of piling up for days
requirements.check: manual: start a host from a temp folder, kill its parent, and confirm it is reported or stopped within the stated time
